source: GShard placed sparse ZXNAME0000XZ layers in a Transformer and scaled them across many devices. Switch Transformer later simplified token routing to one expert. Mixtral replaces the feed-forward blocks with sparse expert layers and routes each token to two experts.
zh: GShard 将稀疏的 ZXNAME0000XZ 层放置在 Transformer 中，并在许多设备上扩展它们。 Switch Transformer 后来简化了将令牌路由给一位专家的过程。 Mixtral 用稀疏专家层替换前馈块，并将每个令牌路由到两个专家。
